narrative.overview:
Alpha cube looks like an engineering war room built by the people who answer pager alerts at 2:00 AM. Deep midnight navy holds the screen in dark mode, while high-key porcelain surfaces take over in light mode with sharp dark ink. Geist Pixel appears only in small hardware indicators, navigation links, buttons, and ASCII portraits, letting Saira carry every real sentence comfortably.

This system rejects generic black glass overlays, floating neon halos, and decorative gradients behind plain copy. Every surface uses solid stepped contrast, clean hairlines, and exact alignment across index.html, style.css, and script.js.
keyCharacteristics: Dark navy canvas (#050E24) as default polarity paired with a high-contrast porcelain light theme (#F7F9FC).
Saira geometric sans for headings and body copy, restricted to short pixel accents for UI controls.
Full-width 1280px container where the fixed header, hero, six-column bento matrix, and closing banner align to the same 32px edges.
Interactive ASCII portrait and live incident bus rendered on HTML canvas and monospace streams with full keyboard and light-mode readability.

rules.name: The Polarity Parity Rule
rules.body: Signal Rose (#FD91CC) handles fills on dark backgrounds, but light backgrounds must shift CTAs to Cobalt Brand (#09318D) and rose text to Signal Rose Ink (#B01E6E) so contrast never drops below 4.5:1.

rules.name: The No-Black-Void Rule
rules.body: Never paint surfaces with pure #000000; anchor dark mode in Midnight Canvas (#050E24) and step containers cleanly through Midnight Surface (#091A44).

rules.name: The Pixel-Accent Cap Rule
rules.body: Limit Geist Pixel (400) to short UI chrome, buttons, badges, and ASCII art; never render multi-sentence paragraphs in pixel type.

rules.name: The Single-Weight Pixel Rule
rules.body: Local GeistPixel.ttf ships only weight 400, so leave font-weight: 400 on every pixel element to avoid synthetic bolding.

rules.name: The Surface Layer Rule
rules.body: Separate resting cards from their parent canvas by one tonal step plus a 1px border before reaching for drop shadows.

dos: Do align header, main sections, and footer inside .site-shell (1280px max width, 32px desktop gutters).
Do verify every interactive rose element on [data-theme="light"] uses #09318D or #8F1458 / #B01E6E rather than pastel pink ink.
Do size every Pixelarticons inline SVG strictly at 16px or 24px with shape-rendering: crispEdges.
Do validate <dialog> forms via HTML attributes plus accessible aria-invalid states before triggering mailto: handoff.
Do keep the closing banner (#contact) clean beside assets/anirudh.png with balanced copy and dual action buttons.
donts: Don't place Geist Pixel on long paragraphs, testimonials, or form inputs.
Don't put interactive nested cards inside bento tiles; keep spec lists and terminals flat inset panes (10px radius).
Don't use pure #000000 backgrounds or blurry frosted overlays on mobile navigation drawers.
Don't introduce unaligned CSS grid rows inside .bento-matrix that leave blank columns at desktop width.
Don't strip prefers-reduced-motion safeguards from the ASCII canvas animation or hero entrance transition.
